sources.title: Project Gigabit network build contract - Bedfordshire, Northamptonshire and Milton Keynes
sources.evidence_location: official HTML May 2026 update and original contract section
facts: The redesigned contract covers around 6,000 premises
The revised investment is £19.8 million
The original contract covered around 25,000 premises
The redesign aims to minimise overlap with commercial rollout
limitations: Redesigned scope is not current orderability
Original and revised scopes must remain separate

sources.title: Project Gigabit network build contract – Dorset and South Somerset
sources.evidence_location: official HTML award and delivery-context sections
facts: Wessex Internet was awarded the contract
The contract covers around 21,400 hard-to-reach premises
The reported contract value is £33.5 million
The contract was signed in March 2024
limitations: An awarded contract is not a completed build
Detailed planning can change the premises reached

sources.title: Project Gigabit network build contract - West Yorkshire and parts of North Yorkshire

sources.geography: West Yorkshire and parts of North Yorkshire
facts: Quickline was awarded the contract

sources.title: Project Gigabit network build contract - Hampshire
sources.evidence_location: official HTML May 2026 update and original contract section
facts: The redesigned contract covers around 29,000 premises
The revised investment is £71.7 million

limitations: Redesigned and original scopes must not be combined
